observations.body: Jesus blesses and gives bread as his body, thanks and gives a cup all drink from, calls it covenant blood poured for many, anticipates new wine in God’s Kingdom, sings, and departs.
observations.label: Bread, covenant blood, kingdom horizon, and hymn

observations.body: The passage presents Blessing, taking, drinking, singing, and departing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Blessing, taking, drinking, singing, and departing

observations.body: The passage places New wine in God’s Kingdom beside Blessing, taking, drinking, singing, and departing.
observations.label: New wine in God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Mark 14:22–26 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus blesses and gives bread as his body, thanks and gives a cup all drink from, calls it covenant blood poured for many, anticipates new wine in God’s Kingdom, sings, and departs. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
